scope: 48 independently reviewed native BODY drawings on 29 selected unchanged PNG pages, bounded to the unvaried Feral/Scar duo. All selected UV borders are alpha0. Per-page anatomical calibration does not fit a lying body to a standing bbox. No source action completion is inferred.

review.scope: Independent native BODY review: unvaried Feral/Scar forward throw only, with separate attacker/victim drawings and independently drawn orientations. Runtime body scale and partner contact are calibrated in the actual renderer.
review.notes: Sources personally reviewed in visual-review.json and visual-review-gutters.json. All 48 native UV regions have strictly transparent borders, preserving original page pixels and native anchors. No reflection, pose interpolation, composite mannequin crop, PNG edit or decoded-pixel filtering. Source completion and other partner/costume requirements remain open. Grounded attacker poses and captured/landing/rising victim poses use the measured alpha128 support edge as their floor pivot. Loaded/flight victims preserve the authored airborne anchor; page anatomical scale remains uniform.
